notes.title: Update 1.0.2.2
notes.notes:
• Stability fixes
• Bug Reporting works - (and sends player logs, which will help with debugging)
• You can access language and settings from start menu
• Abilities tooltips show how much thier cooldown is lowered by

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.6
notes.notes:
• Selected language not saving - fixed
• Amount of items left to farm in each set / puzzle is shown
• UI / showing clickable abilities changing things around

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.3
notes.notes:
• Game saves automatically after each puzzle is finished - meaning - if there is a crash your progress will be retained - at least to some point
• Minor UI fixes in the girls menu (the left-hand girl portrait getting stuck sometimes - fixed)

notes.title: Update to version 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
• 3440x1440 resolution is playable (Still not perfect but getting there)
• English language fixes
• Abilities in the abilities bar separated into active and passive

(The game plays best at 1920 x 1080 and has issues on other resolutions but that will be fixed shortly)
